sources.title: 心一堂2014《新命理探原》出版社说明：1915/1916早作与1950年代香港修订印本
sources.provider: 心一堂2014 first-party editorial notice via 秀威书店
sources.quality_notes: Publisher ISBN9789888266692 states the 2014 facsimile was reproduced from an identified private Xu Bailu-held 1950s Hong Kong Runde reprint; claims early 命理探原 composed 1915, first published 1916, late author revision 新命理探原. This is NOT an inspection of that private physical original, and its identity/printing plates are not bound to NCL-000002203. NCL first-party metadata 1915 is separately registered in 15U but NCL-source PDF browser text contains later author 辛卯 (1951) revised preface; source/PDF target-page SHA unavailable, original glyph not attested here. The modern product page alternates title 原/源. Does not prove 1927 Xinming issue original, 上海命學苑/宛 original spelling or organizational relationship with 1934 命學社.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: 1915 NCL catalog date cannot date the later 1951 辛卯 preface as 1915 author text
Modern private 1950s facsimile base is not proven identical to NCL-000002203 physical copy
Yuan's circa-1951 Shanghai 命學苑之新命 recollection does not prove the 1927 print original name or 1934 命學社 direct lineage
unresolved_lineage_questions: Verify original physical imprint and exact bound pages in NCL-000002203
Acquire original 1927 新命 issue and association declaration without relying on 2018 product description
Compare early 1916 命理探原 imprint and later Yuan author revised text at date/edition/copy scope
